resources.string: Build columns downward: put a card on a card one rank higher, in any suit.
A run moves only if all its cards are one suit and in order. Drag it, or tap it and then a column.
Out of moves? Deal a row from the stock, once every column holds a card.
A full run from King to Ace in one suit leaves the table. Clear all eight to win.
Stuck? Use Hint, or Undo as often as you like.
Spider Solitaire uses two decks, 104 cards in all, and is named for the eight finished runs that clear the table, one for each leg of a spider.
Each turn, play one card from your hand onto a field card of the same month.
No match? The card stays on the field. Two matches? You choose one.
Then turn up the top card of the deck and match it the same way.
Captured cards are Brights, Animals, Ribbons or Plains. Sets of them make combinations called yaku.
With a combination, call Koi-Koi to keep playing for more, or Shobu to score and end the round.
Seven points or more count double, and so do points won after an opponent\'s Koi-Koi.
Hanafuda means flower cards. The deck has 48 cards, four for each of the twelve months, and Koi-Koi, which means come on, is one of the most popular games played with it.
